items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charles McCraken – it looks like a string section... [INTERVIEWEE] That’s why I did it.

ctx.x: That was in April and May of ’71, Freddie Hubbard, Kenny, Ron Carter, Billy Cobham. Charles McCraken – it looks like a string section, Don Sebesky arranging.
